hypothesis: If all domestic pigeon breeds descend from Columba livia, then genome-wide data from diverse domestic breeds will show them nested within the C. livia variation (feral/rock pigeon), with no breed forming a lineage separate from C. livia.
pass_criterion: Using autosomal SNPs from the resequenced pigeon groups (feral, Shiraz tumbler, Persian high flyer, homing), a neighbour-joining or ML tree and PCA show all domestic breeds in one clade with the feral C. livia samples, with every domestic breed sample having pairwise Fst against feral C. livia below 0.25 and no domestic breed forming a monophyletic group outside C. livia (bootstrap support for a breed-clade separate from feral C. livia below 70%).
fail_criterion: One or more domestic breeds form a clade with at least 90% bootstrap support that is separated from feral C. livia by genetic distance or Fst of at least 0.5, or an ADMIXTURE analysis at the best-supported K assigns more than 25% ancestry in any breed to a component absent from feral C. livia.
interpretation: 'Descended from Columba livia with its geographical sub-species, not from several aboriginal wild stocks' is mapped to monophyly or nesting of domestic breeds within C. livia genomic variation. 'Breeds, however different' means the sampled breeds (here a modest sample of four groups, a limit of this dataset). Modern reinterpretation: descent is tested as genome-wide SNP clustering and admixture, and gene flow from other Columba species is considered as a separate caveat. Wild rock doves are not in this dataset, so feral pigeons serve as the C. livia reference.

dataset.name: Whole genome resequencing data for rock pigeon (Columba livia) (BioProject PRJNA532675)
dataset.publisher: NCBI Sequence Read Archive / BioProject (data note in PMC8351366)
dataset.why_it_fits: It holds raw reads for 95 rock pigeon genomes (29 feral, 24 Shiraz tumblers, 24 Persian high flyers, 18 homing pigeons), so domestic breeds can be tested against feral C. livia. Fields used: SRA run accessions and sample/breed labels, aligned to the C. livia reference, then SNP calls for tree, PCA, Fst and ADMIXTURE. The data note PMC8351366 describes the GATK SNP calling.
